covers: The US close on Friday 20 Nov 2026, weekend prices for the rand and commodities to early Monday 23 Nov, and the week ahead
headline: Wall Street ends its worst week since April 2025: Nasdaq -5.3% on Friday, Nvidia -14%, S&P 500 in correction
summary: The JSE All Share closed Friday 20 Nov 2026 at 104,638.77 (-1.5%) and the rand was at R17.49 per dollar early on Monday 23 Nov, little changed from Friday (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). After the JSE closed, US selling deepened: the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39 and the Nasdaq 5.3% to 22,617.73, leaving the S&P 500 down 8.6% on the week and 10% below its 6 Oct record, with Nvidia down 14% (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance, 20 Nov 2026). Gold futures were at $3,582.90 and Brent at $89.39 in Sunday trade, so the JSE opens into a week where US markets close on Thursday for Thanksgiving.

items.title: Nvidia falls 14% to $125.53, leading a 5.3% drop in the Nasdaq
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $125.53 on 20 Nov 2026, down about 14% on the day and down about a third over two weeks; Investopedia links the fall to investors weighing Jensen Huang's departure as CEO, and a separate Reuters report that SEC staff are looking at possible accounting issues has not been confirmed by the SEC or Nvidia (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance; Sanctity, 20 Nov 2026). AMD fell 13%, and SanDisk and Nebius 16% each. Nvidia is a covered company; its rating is unchanged and will be reviewed against its trigger levels by the analyst, not by this desk.

items.title: S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.3%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.9%)
items.summary: Friday 20 Nov 2026 was the S&P 500's seventh straight daily fall; on the week the S&P 500 lost 8.6%, the Nasdaq 10% and the Dow 8%, the worst week since early April 2025. The S&P 500 and Dow are now in correction (more than 10% below their highs), the Nasdaq is down about 3% for 2026, and the VIX volatility gauge rose 26% to near 36. The 10-year Treasury yield was about 4.91–4.94% (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance; Alain Guillot recap, 20 Nov 2026).

items.title: Big tech also lower: Tesla -7.6%, Amazon -4.1%, Microsoft -2.8%, Alphabet -2.7%, Apple -1.9%
items.summary: Friday 20 Nov 2026 closing moves (LRC Stock Scanner, Yahoo Finance prices). This is a short trading week in the US: markets are closed on Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving.

items.title: JSE starts the week after a 1.5% fall on Friday; All Share 104,638.77, Top 40 96,832.98
items.summary: The JSE closed on 20 Nov 2026 before most of Wall Street's Friday selling, so rand-hedge and tech-linked shares such as Naspers (-4.6% on Friday at R628) and Prosus (-3.5%) may again feel US moves (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance). A weekend market note found about two-thirds of JSE shares it tracks in weak or oversold trends, with telecoms (Vodacom, Telkom, MTN) and food retailers (Shoprite, Pick n Pay) the relative strong spots (Unum Capital, 22 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand at R17.49/$ early Monday; euro R19.22, pound R22.93
items.summary: USD/ZAR was 17.4947 on 23 Nov 2026, against 17.4946 on 20 Nov, so the rand held its level over the weekend after a 4.2% weekly fall (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance).

items.title: Gold $3,582.90 after Friday's 4% fall; Brent $89.39, platinum $1,290, copper $11,969/t
items.summary: Gold futures fell about 4% to near $3,540 on Friday 20 Nov 2026 (Investopedia via Yahoo Finance) and were at $3,582.90 in Sunday 22 Nov trade. Brent was $89.39, down from $92.57 on 20 Nov, as heavy Gulf exports offset Middle East attacks; platinum was $1,290 and copper $11,969 a tonne (LRC Market Dashboard, Yahoo Finance front-month futures, 22 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia -14.0% to $125.53, Intuit -12.8% to $270.44, Meta -5.9% to $560.84, Deckers -1.3% to $77.94
items.summary: Friday 20 Nov 2026 closes (LRC Stock Scanner, Yahoo Finance prices). Intuit extended Thursday's fall after cutting its full-year revenue outlook (Intuit 8-K, 19 Nov 2026); Meta and Nvidia fell with the wider AI sell-off. No ratings have changed.

items.title: MTN at R221.80 and Telkom at R66.37 going into the week
items.summary: Both closed lower on 20 Nov 2026 (MTN -1.3%, Telkom -1.0%) but telecoms remain the JSE's relatively strongest group in recent trading (LRC Stock Scanner; Unum Capital, 22 Nov 2026). No ratings have changed.

watch_today: Whether the JSE follows Friday's 3.7% S&P 500 and 5.3% Nasdaq falls, especially Naspers and Prosus
Nvidia after a 14% drop and reports about its leadership and accounting
Rand near R17.49/$ and gold near $3,580
Dell results after the US close on Tue 24 Nov 2026
Short US week: markets closed Thursday 26 Nov for Thanksgiving
